name: 44107 · Lakewood, OH
findings: ZIP 44107 (Lakewood) has 168 nonprofit organizations. 66 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 59 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 44107 (Lakewood) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 17 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 27% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 44107 (Lakewood) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 27% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Few social and fraternal organizations list volunteering
observations.text: 2 social and fraternal organizations here list volunteering. In similar places of this size, about 5 would.
